# Visual asset provenance

Prepared on 2026-10-21 for the QuoteLens interface redesign.

## Current interface: selected ATELIER

The user selected ATELIER from two interactive directions on 21 October 2026. [ProSave — B2B Procurement Platform UI/UX Redesign](https://www.behance.net/gallery/249980381/ProSave-B2B-Procurement-Platform-UIUX-Redesign) by Alina Volodina informed its light typography, warm surfaces and staged composition. That Behance project is All Rights Reserved; no artwork, screenshots, device image, source files, brand or UI code were copied.

The purchase-request/quote papers are original HTML/CSS with text and values derived from the real fictional preview. They are not an image asset or evidence of PDF parsing. The coral lens mark in `icon.svg`, bolt line drawing and integration code are original project work under MIT. Short motion is CSS/DOM interaction, not a WebGL or rendered-3D claim.

- SIL OFL 1.1; complete original copyright/license: [InstrumentSans-OFL.txt](InstrumentSans-OFL.txt).

## glass-study.png

An original AI-generated decorative sculpture produced with the built-in image generation tool on 2026-10-21. It does not depict product functionality or a customer result. No artwork from the user's Lifemed reference was copied or supplied as an edit target. The reference informed broad art direction only: white space, restrained type and translucent glass.

- File: 1254 × 1254 PNG, 32-bit RGBA with transparent alpha.
- Bytes: 1,783,450.
- SHA-256: `8016b9e8be530f3ef74e041a13ea77833bc8a4506920cb94602be14a516d2361`.
- Visual inspection: overlapping folded glass sheets, lavender/cobalt/rose refraction; no logos, text or UI. The background alpha was checked separately.

### Final generation prompt

> Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original premium website hero sculpture, isolated on genuine transparent alpha, no opaque backdrop. Create a photorealistic optical glass sculpture for a refined quote-comparison product: three broad translucent folded glass sheets overlap in a restrained sculptural stack, like gently bowed rectangular pages with softly rounded corners and deep bevels. Not a literal paper document and no writing. Three-quarter studio view, diagonally balanced, occupies about 80% of square frame, fully visible silhouette with breathing room. Truly transparent colorless glass body with sophisticated lilac, cobalt blue and faint rose iridescent refraction only along the folds and edges. Fluid thick smooth glass, sharp caustic detail, soft specular highlights, subtle luminous reflected blue near base. Editorial high-end product CGI, physical ray tracing, extremely polished and architectural. Strong clear sculptural volume; predominantly pale white-lavender glass, not a solid purple object. Lighting broad white studio softboxes, crisp beautiful highlights and believable optical refraction. Constraints: original form, no logos, no text, no UI, no watermark, no icons, no stock cartoon, no pedestal, no dark background, no grain, no glitter, no surrounding objects, no copied artwork. This must be suitable for compositing on a clean white website.
